name: Persian Subtitle Fixes
description: Fixes common errors in Persian (Farsi) subtitles with 1,500+ rules in 12 groups: Arabic to Persian letters, spaces, zero-width non-joiners (نیم‌فاصله), punctuation, dialog dashes, abbreviations, OCR errors and more. Every change is previewed with highlighted differences and can be picked one by one. Rules by Mohammad Sasan (msasanmh).
author: Mohammad Sasan (msasanmh), SE5 port by Subtitle Edit
